segmentClass.instructions: Classify the supplied bounded media segment by its semantic role. Judge only whether it is primary program content, materially sponsorship/promotional content, or ambiguous.

criteria.primary: The segment materially advances the main editorial, educational, entertainment, or requested program content.
criteria.sponsorship: The segment materially promotes a sponsor, product, service, affiliate offer, discount, or paid placement rather than advancing the primary program content.
criteria.ambiguous: The segment mixes program and promotional content, or the supplied excerpt is insufficient to classify reliably.
